[[File:Abafar_menu_2.png|thumb|left|Fambaa Delight on Ower Sliders' menu.]]
'''Fambaa Delight''' was a type of dish made with [[Fambaa/Legends|Fambaa]] meat. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Fambaa Delight was served on [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora's]] [[Power Sliders/Legends|Power Sliders]], located on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]].
